Name: ValleyCast
Author: ihasTacoFML
Description:
[size=5][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
[b]Tested with OBS Studio v31.0.3 & Stardew Valley 1.6.15[/b]
May not work with Streamlabs OBS yet, testing needed.
Currently tested only on Windows.

Source code: [url=https://github.com/ihasTaco/ValleyCast]https://github.com/ihasTaco/ValleyCast[/url]

[size=5][b]Setup[/b][/size]

[b]Configure OBS Studio[/b]:
• Open OBS Studio
• Go to Tools > WebSocket Server Settings
• Click "Show Connection Info" and set this window aside

[b]Launch Stardew Valley[/b]:
• Make sure [b]SMAPI[/b] and [b]Generic Mod Configuration Menu[/b] are installed
• Launch Stardew through SMAPI

[b]Set Up ValleyCast[/b]:
• Click the [b]cog icon[/b] in the bottom-left of the screen
• Select [b]ValleyCast[/b] from the menu
• Enter your OBS connection info (IP and Port) from the WebSocket settings window
[b]Note:[/b] If OBS and Stardew are on the same machine, defaults will usually work. For separate devices, use your local IP and matching port.

[size=5][b]Features (v0.1.6)[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]NEW! | Hot Reload Support[/b]: Instantly reload config.json in-game via [b]F5[/b] or the GMCM checkbox
[*][b]NEW! | Dynamic Text Updates[/b]: Auto-updates an OBS text source at day start (e.g. “Day 4, Spring, Year 1”)
[*][b]Integrated Mod Settings[/b]: Configure everything in-game with Generic Mod Config Menu
[*][b]OBS Integration[/b]: Controls OBS Studio using WebSockets with zero fuss
[*][b]In-Game Notifications[/b]: Alerts you when OBS connects, disconnects, or config reloads
[*][b]Save Load Recording Toggle[/b]: Automatically starts recording when a save loads
[*][b]Day-End Recording Toggle[/b]: Restarts recording after each in-game day
[*][b]Improved Error Handling[/b]: Cleaner logs, safer reconnects, and resilient configs
[*][b]All the Logs™[/b]: SMAPI logs everything, from triggers to WebSocket payloads
[/list]
[size=5][b]Known Bugs[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]OBS recording state detection ([i]IsRecording[/i]) isn’t working correctly in the current version
[*]Scene switching and weekly/monthly toggles are implemented but not yet configurable
[*]Not tested on macOS or Streamlabs OBS
[/list]
